• Amtrak’s “Pet Friendly” policy applies. | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: [Amtrak – Miami](https://www.amtrak.com/stations/mia) | | **Miami Central Station (Amtrak)** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 (same as above) | Same policy as the Intermodal Center. | Phone: (305) 284‑4000 | | **Miami International Airport (MIA) – Amtrak & Metrobus** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | • Pets allowed in the Amtrak car.
• Metrobus allows small pets in carriers. | Phone: (305) 284‑4000 | > **Note:** Amtrak’s pet policy generally allows one pet per passenger, must be in a carrier or on a leash, and the pet must be well‑behaved. There may be a small fee for pets. Always call ahead to confirm the latest rules and any changes. --- ### Quick Tips for Traveling with Pets in Miami 1. **Check the Amtrak Pet Policy** – Visit the Amtrak website or call the station to confirm any recent updates or fees. 2. **Book Early** – Reserve a seat for your pet in advance if possible. 3. **Prepare a Carrier** – Make sure it meets Amtrak’s size and safety requirements. 4. **Stay Hydrated** – Bring a water bowl and a few treats for your pet. 5. **Plan for Breaks** – If you’re traveling a long distance, plan stops where you can walk your pet. --- If you need more detailed information or help with booking a ticket, let me know!
